Name: Shaved Ice and Frozen Treats
Author: Hadi42
AuthorLabel: Hadi and Zosa and Fwippy and Shads42
TagLine: Everyone knows there's no such thing as TOO much ice cream... so here's 26 new recipes and a Shaved Ice Machine for good measure.
Description:
**[This mod is now being maintained by Shads4242]**

Presenting.... even MORE sweet frozen treats for your gourmet palate! There's plenty of ice cream mods out there, but how about fancy ones that use [Cornucopia Crops](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508) , [Artisanal Soda products](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173), __and__ feature cute sprites from the talented[Zosa](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/55392892)?

What about an __entire new machine__ just for shaved ice treats in all sorts of flavors??? (Disclaimer: this one was unfortunately designed by me, Hadi)

This mod adds 28 new objects, 1 new (animated!) machine, a metric butt-ton of shaved ice flavors (including Floral Shaved Ices, compliments of the wonderful [Fwippy!](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/64051321)) and compliments several large mods already out there!

The Shaved Ice Machine and recipes for all these goodies can be bought at Gus' shop. Ice can also be bought there.

**__New in 3.1!__
**

*   Added a minor bugfix with the animations for the machine

*   Added a manually configured version of the mod
**Please keep in mind that most of the ice creams and fancy desserts require Cornucopia mods, so if you don't have them they won't be added to your game.**

**Troubleshooting:**__
- Chocolate, Vanilla, and Strawberry Ice Cream for use in the cooking recipes can be bought at either Gus' Saloon or Alex's ice cream stand in the summer
- Ice can be bought from Gus
- Floral shaved ices require the mod[Artisanal Soda Makers - Flower Pack Continued
](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33086)- You can only play with one version of the mod at a time. If you are getting a duplicate key error for this mod, it means that you have both the automatically and the manually configured versions of the mod installed. Removing one will solve this issue.
- If you run into an issue with the mod, please open a bug report. Include the following information:
    1) A SMAPI log
    2) Whether you are using the regular or manually configured
    3) Your configuration settings (only required for the manual mod config version)

-**THIS MOD IS NOT STRICTLY BALANCED!** It's not __unbalanced__ either, but the food items are meant for fun and variety more than profit, so don't expect to always make more money from the finished product than the ingredients. If you must balance it, feel free to edit for personal use **OR** submit your edits so I can share them with everyone! (Your work, ofc will be credited).

Thanks to [Kaya](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48693548) for the integrated Korean translation! You are a modding angel <3
